start_here: Say to your AI: "List my TidyCal bookings." It runs tool:list-my-tidycal-bookings with no input.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your TidyCal account and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List my TidyCal bookings". It calls tools:run with tool tool:list-my-tidycal-bookings and an empty input.
2. Read each booking's id, start and end, cancellation time and meeting link.
3. Booker names and emails are personal: show them only to the account owner.

worked_examples.title: List the bookings on my TidyCal account
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: a GET to https://tidycal.com/api/bookings with the vault key tidycal-api-token as a bearer header. Reads only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the bookings, for example booking 12345 "starts 2026-11-25 10:00 UTC, cancelled_at null, meeting link present" with the booker's email kept out of the answer.
